# Command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-command-docs.ts — do not edit by hand. Run: pnpm docs:commands -->

Every command accepts the global options below. Commands that take a video accept a file ID, a
`docs.google.com/videos/…` URL or a `drive.google.com/…` URL.

## Global options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-V, --version` | print the gvids version |
| `--json` | JSON envelope output (the default) |
| `--human` | human-readable output instead of JSON |
| `--pretty` | indent JSON output |
| `--progress` | stream progress events as JSON lines on stderr |
| `-q, --quiet` | suppress progress output |
| `-v, --verbose` | more detail (JSON log lines on stderr) |
| `--debug` | debug logs, plus Playwright traces and diagnostics (see: gvids config path) |
| `-y, --yes` | confirm destructive or public actions (never prompted) |
| `--dry-run` | validate and describe the command without running it |
| `--detach` | run in the background; returns a task id for `gvids wait` |
| `--no-color` | disable colors in --human output |
| `--timeout <duration>` | limit for long operations, e.g. 90s, 10m, 1h |
| `--headless` | run the automation browser without a window |
| `--headed` | show the automation browser window |
| `--no-drive-api` | never use the Drive API (browser fallbacks only), even when signed in |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 1 | generic error |
| 2 | invalid arguments or usage |
| 3 | authentication required (OAuth or browser sign-in) |
| 4 | permission denied |
| 5 | not found |
| 6 | feature unavailable for this account, region, or UI |
| 7 | browser automation failure (UI changed, session problem) |
| 8 | generation or render timeout |
| 9 | Google API failure |
| 130 | cancelled by user |

## Output

By default every command prints exactly one JSON envelope on stdout (one line; `--pretty` indents it):

```json
{"ok":true,"data":{"…":"…"},"error":null}
{"ok":false,"data":null,"error":{"code":"LOGIN_REQUIRED","message":"…","exitCode":3,"retryable":false,"needsUser":true,"next":["gvids browser login"]}}
```

The exit code is 0 exactly when `ok` is true. Warnings travel in the envelope (`"warnings": [...]`).
stderr stays silent unless `--progress` (JSON-line events) or `--verbose`/`--debug` (JSON-line logs).
`--human` prints human-readable output instead. Exceptions: `guide` prints Markdown and `completion` a
shell script (unless `--json`), `mcp` speaks MCP on stdio. `--dry-run` validates the arguments and
describes the command without running it (it wins over `--detach`).

Each command below lists its **effect** (read, write, destructive), its **backend** (local, drive,
browser, drive|browser, oauth) and flags: needs `--yes`, uses AI allowance, slow, needs a person.

## Commands

### gvids guide

How to use gvids as an agent: output contract, errors, recipes, limits (Markdown)

effect: **read** · backend: `local` · idempotent

```
gvids guide
```

### gvids commands

List every command with its effect, backend and requirements (--full: arguments and options)

effect: **read** · backend: `local` · idempotent

```
gvids commands [prefix]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `prefix` | only commands starting with these words, e.g. "scene" |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--full` | include arguments, options and examples |

### gvids batch

Run several gvids commands in one call; input is JSON (array of argument arrays)

effect: **write** · backend: `local`  
Runs other gvids commands; each keeps its own effect and needs its own --yes.

```
gvids batch [file]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `file` | JSON file with the commands; omit or "-" to read stdin |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--keep-going` | continue after a failing command (default: stop at the first failure) |

### gvids auth

Google OAuth sign-in for the Drive API

### gvids auth login

Sign in with Google (OAuth loopback + PKCE) and store tokens securely

effect: **write** · backend: `oauth` · needs a person  
Opens a browser for Google consent.

```
gvids auth login
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--scopes <profile>` | scope profile to request — one of: `full`, `readonly` |
| `--client-secret-file <file>` | OAuth "Desktop app" client JSON (copied to ~/.gvids) |
| `--client-id <id>` | OAuth client ID (alternative to a JSON file) |
| `--client-secret <secret>` | OAuth client secret |
| `--no-browser` | print the sign-in URL instead of opening a browser |
| `--port <port>` | fixed loopback port for the OAuth redirect (default: random) |
| `--login-hint <email>` | pre-select this Google account |

### gvids auth logout

Revoke and delete stored OAuth tokens (a person must sign in again afterwards)

effect: **destructive** · backend: `oauth` · needs `--yes` · idempotent  
Revokes the Drive API login; only a person can sign in again.

```
gvids auth logout
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--no-revoke` | only delete local tokens; do not revoke them at Google |

### gvids auth status

Show which Google account the Drive API uses (fails with AUTH_REQUIRED and the status as data when not signed in)

effect: **read** · backend: `oauth` · idempotent

```
gvids auth status
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--no-verify` | do not contact Google to verify the token |

### gvids auth scopes

Explain the OAuth scopes gvids requests

effect: **read** · backend: `local` · idempotent

```
gvids auth scopes
```

### gvids login

Alias for `gvids auth login`

effect: **write** · backend: `oauth` · needs a person  
Alias of auth login.

```
gvids login
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--scopes <profile>` | scope profile to request — one of: `full`, `readonly` |
| `--client-secret-file <file>` | OAuth "Desktop app" client JSON (copied to ~/.gvids) |
| `--client-id <id>` | OAuth client ID (alternative to a JSON file) |
| `--client-secret <secret>` | OAuth client secret |
| `--no-browser` | print the sign-in URL instead of opening a browser |
| `--port <port>` | fixed loopback port for the OAuth redirect (default: random) |
| `--login-hint <email>` | pre-select this Google account |

### gvids browser

Manage the dedicated browser profile used for Vids editor automation

### gvids browser login

Open a normal browser window to sign in to Google (you handle password/MFA/CAPTCHA)

effect: **write** · backend: `browser` · needs a person  
A person signs in to Google in a window.

```

```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--wait <duration>` | how long to wait for you to finish and close the window (default: `15m`) |
| `--no-verify` | skip the headless sign-in check afterwards |

### gvids browser status

Show the browser profile state and whether it is signed in (fails with LOGIN_REQUIRED and the status as data when not signed in)

effect: **read** · backend: `browser` · idempotent

```
gvids browser status
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--no-check` | do not launch the browser to verify sign-in |

### gvids browser open

Start the gvids browser and leave it running so later commands reuse it (~2 s instead of ~6 s each); --headless keeps it hidden

effect: **write** · backend: `browser` · idempotent  
Keeps a browser running for faster commands; --headless for a hidden one. Close with browser close.

```
gvids browser open [id]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | video ID or URL to open |

### gvids browser close

Close the running gvids browser (refuses while gvids commands still use it, unless --force)

effect: **write** · backend: `browser` · idempotent  
Refuses while other gvids commands use the browser, unless --force.

```
gvids browser close
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--force` | close it even if gvids commands are using it (they will fail) |

### gvids browser reset

Delete the gvids browser profile (signs the automation browser out)

effect: **destructive** · backend: `local` · needs `--yes`  
Deletes the browser profile; a person must sign in again.


### gvids list (alias: `ls`)

List your Google Vids (Drive API; without an OAuth login, recent videos from the Vids home page)

effect: **read** · backend: `drive|browser` · idempotent  
Without OAuth: recent videos from the Vids home page.

```
gvids list
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | maximum number of results (default: `30`) |
| `--all` | fetch every page of results |
| `--folder <id\|url>` | only videos directly inside this Drive folder |
| `--order-by <field>` | sort field — one of: `modifiedTime`, `createdTime`, `name`, `viewedByMeTime` |
| `--asc` | ascending sort (default is newest first) |
| `--shared-with-me` | only videos shared with you |
| `--starred` | only starred videos |
| `--trashed` | show videos in the trash instead |
| `--owner <me\|email>` | only videos owned by this user |
| `--drive <shared-drive-id>` | search a specific shared drive |
| `--ids` | return only file IDs (data.ids) |

### gvids search

Search Google Vids by title, content, date or owner (Drive API; without an OAuth login, the Vids home search by title)

effect: **read** · backend: `drive|browser` · idempotent  
Without OAuth: the Vids home search (title matches).

```
gvids search [text]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | text to look for in the title (or content with --full-text) |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--full-text` | match content and description as well as the title |
| `--modified-after <date>` | modified after YYYY-MM-DD |
| `--modified-before <date>` | modified before YYYY-MM-DD |
| `--created-after <date>` | created after YYYY-MM-DD |
| `-n, --limit <n>` | maximum number of results (default: `30`) |
| `--all` | fetch every page of results |
| `--folder <id\|url>` | only videos directly inside this Drive folder |
| `--order-by <field>` | sort field — one of: `modifiedTime`, `createdTime`, `name`, `viewedByMeTime` |
| `--asc` | ascending sort (default is newest first) |
| `--shared-with-me` | only videos shared with you |
| `--starred` | only starred videos |
| `--trashed` | show videos in the trash instead |
| `--owner <me\|email>` | only videos owned by this user |
| `--drive <shared-drive-id>` | search a specific shared drive |
| `--ids` | return only file IDs (data.ids) |

### gvids share

Share a video with a person, group, domain or anyone with the link (Drive API; falls back to the share dialog without an OAuth login)

effect: **write** · backend: `drive|browser` · may need `--yes` · idempotent  
--anyone and --domain (public access) need --yes.

```
gvids share <id> [email]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | video ID or URL |
| `email` | e-mail address of the person or group |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--role <role>` | reader | commenter | writer (default: `reader`) |
| `--anyone [role]` | share with anyone who has the link (requires confirmation) |
| `--domain <domain>` | share with everyone in a Google Workspace domain |
| `--group` | the e-mail address is a Google Group |
| `--no-notify` | do not send a notification e-mail |
| `--message <text>` | message to include in the notification e-mail |
| `--discoverable` | let people find the file in search (anyone/domain only; Drive API) |

### gvids unshare

effect: **destructive** · backend: `drive|browser` · needs `--yes`


| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | video ID or URL |
| `email` | e-mail address to remove |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--anyone` | turn off "anyone with the link" access |
| `--domain <domain>` | remove domain-wide access |
| `--permission-id <id>` | remove a specific permission by ID |


### gvids create

Create a new Google Vids video (blank, template, upload, Slides, or AI storyboard)

effect: **write** · backend: `browser` · may use AI allowance · slow (consider `--detach`)  
--prompt (storyboard) and --slides (AI narration) use Gemini.

```
gvids create [title]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | title for the new video |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--blank` | blank video (default) |
| `--template <name>` | start from a template (see: gvids template list) |
| `--template-scenes <list>` | only insert these template scenes, e.g. 1,3 |
| `--slides <id\|url>` | convert a Google Slides presentation |
| `--upload <file>` | start from a local video/image file |
| `-p, --prompt <text\|file\|->` | generate an AI storyboard draft from a prompt |
| `--prompt-file <file>` | read the storyboard prompt from a file |
| `--outline-file <file>` | use your own outline for the storyboard draft |
| `--design <n>` | storyboard design to use (1-based) |
| `--format <format>` | video format — one of: `landscape`, `portrait`, `square` (default: `landscape`) |
| `--folder <id\|url>` | move the new video into this Drive folder (Drive API) |
| `--open` | open the new video in your default browser |
| `--via-api` | create an empty Vids file with Drive files.create instead of the editor (experimental) |

### gvids storyboard

Gemini storyboard ("Help me create"): prompt → outline → draft video (browser)

### gvids storyboard generate

Generate an AI storyboard draft in a new, still-unedited video

effect: **write** · backend: `browser` · uses AI allowance · slow (consider `--detach`)

```
gvids storyboard generate <id>
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | video ID or URL (Vids only offers the storyboard before a video is edited) |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --prompt <text\|file\|->` | what the video is about (text, a .txt/.md file, or - for stdin) |
| `--prompt-file <file>` | read the prompt from a file |
| `--design <n>` | which of the offered designs to use (1-based) (default: `1`) |
| `--outline-file <file>` | replace Gemini’s outline with your own topics (JSON/YAML list or one per line) |
| `--context-drive-file <name...>` | Drive files to @-mention as context (experimental) |
| `--outline-only` | stop after the outline and print it (no draft is created) |

### gvids storyboard regenerate

Like generate, but asks Gemini for a different outline first ("Try again")

effect: **write** · backend: `browser` · uses AI allowance · slow (consider `--detach`)

```

```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | video ID or URL (must still be a new, unedited video) |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--attempts <n>` | how many times to request a new outline (default: `1`) |
| `-p, --prompt <text\|file\|->` | what the video is about (text, a .txt/.md file, or - for stdin) |
| `--prompt-file <file>` | read the prompt from a file |
| `--design <n>` | which of the offered designs to use (1-based) (default: `1`) |
| `--outline-file <file>` | replace Gemini’s outline with your own topics (JSON/YAML list or one per line) |
| `--context-drive-file <name...>` | Drive files to @-mention as context (experimental) |
| `--outline-only` | stop after the outline and print it (no draft is created) |

### gvids ai generate

Generate an AI video clip from text (and optional reference images)

effect: **write** · backend: `browser` · uses AI allowance · slow (consider `--detach`)
